scope: Visual refinement of the victory journey card in training-flow-v5.
migrations: The prototype reads an in-memory synthetic session; no database or unapplied database migration is required.
changesAfterVisualReview: Replaced the generic rounded card with one continuous generated frame in the modal's gold, navy enamel and sapphire style.
Rejected the first shallow rail composition; regenerated the frame with a taller interior and finer border. The final bitmap is never sliced or stretched.
Moved current and target times into their own reserved regions, clear of the gold lock, title and footer.
Created closed/open normal/active lock states together; normalized all cells with the same crop and scale.
Downsampled the approved fox to 256px wide before display, removing visible aliasing in the tablet card.
The measured progress transition finishes before the closed lock cross-fades to the open one. No reward logic runs from the animation.
Preserved all three large comparison signs and their existing font size; their rendered text fits the reserved region.

verification.wordsHiddenAndAudioNotNeeded: Inspected the problem pictogram, measured bar, clock, lock, arrow and fox without word labels.
verification.newVisibleLabels: No new prose or instructional text.
verification.finalHumanBrowser: Existing catacombs gallery opened on the revised victory example.

limits: This is the interactive design prototype, not a production Phaser integration.
Tablet viewport and touch emulation were reviewed; no physical-tablet or child playtest was performed.
The existing shared model controls thresholds and rewards. Proposed fox abilities and higher speed tiers are outside this visual revision.
The disabled card was exercised as a visual review state; normal routing leaves the card enabled.
